transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy work or lifting for 1 month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate the information. I am also very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it is mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any more questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in turn 7 ("Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens."). However, the agent did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice`.
